{

def test_r1_russian_plural_second_singular():
    from arrow.locales import RussianLocale
    locale = RussianLocale()
    result = locale.describe('seconds', delta=1)
    assert isinstance(result, str)
    assert len(result) > 0

def test_r1_russian_plural_second_plural():
    from arrow.locales import RussianLocale
    locale = RussianLocale()
    result_singular = locale.describe('seconds', delta=1)
    result_plural = locale.describe('seconds', delta=2)
    assert result_singular != result_plural

def test_r1_russian_plural_second_different_forms():
    from arrow.locales import RussianLocale
    locale = RussianLocale()
    result_2 = locale.describe('seconds', delta=2)
    result_5 = locale.describe('seconds', delta=5)
    assert result_2 != result_5

def test_r1_russian_plural_second_edge_numbers():
    from arrow.locales import RussianLocale
    locale = RussianLocale()
    result_21 = locale.describe('seconds', delta=21)
    result_11 = locale.describe('seconds', delta=11)
    assert result_21 != result_11

def test_r6_slavic_dehumanize_russian():
    from arrow.locales import RussianLocale
    locale = RussianLocale()
    now = Arrow.utcnow()
    humanized = now.shift(seconds=-5).humanize(locale='ru')

    from arrow.locales import CzechLocale
    locale = CzechLocale()
    now = Arrow.utcnow()
    humanized = now.shift(hours=-2).humanize(locale='cs')
    dehumanized = Arrow.dehumanize(humanized, locale='cs')

from arrow import Arrow

def test_r7_slovak_dehumanize_roundtrip():
    now = Arrow.utcnow()
    humanized = now.shift(minutes=-5).humanize(locale='sk')
    dehumanized = Arrow.dehumanize(humanized, locale='sk')
    diff = now - dehumanized
    abs_diff = abs(diff.total_seconds())
    assert abs_diff < 10

def test_r7_czech_dehumanize_future():
    now = Arrow.utcnow()

    diff = now - dehumanized

def test_r7_slovak_dehumanize_future():
    now = Arrow.utcnow()

    diff = now - dehumanized

def test_r8_norwegian_ordinal_with_period():
    from arrow.locales import NorwegianLocale
    locale = NorwegianLocale()
    for n in [1, 2, 3, 10, 21]:
        ordinal = locale.ordinal_number(n)
        assert ordinal.endswith('.'), f"Norwegian ordinal for {n} should end with '.'"

def test_r8_new_norwegian_ordinal_with_period():
    from arrow.locales import NewNorwegianLocale
    locale = NewNorwegianLocale()
    for n in [1, 2, 3, 10, 21]:
        ordinal = locale.ordinal_number(n)
        assert ordinal.endswith('.'), f"New Norwegian ordinal for {n} should end with '.'"

def test_r8_portuguese_ordinal_no_period():
    from arrow.locales import PortugueseLocale
    locale = PortugueseLocale()
    for n in [1, 2, 3, 10, 21]:
        ordinal = locale.ordinal_number(n)
        assert not ordinal.endswith('.'), f"Portuguese ordinal for {n} should not end with '.'"

def test_r8_portuguese_ordinal_starts_with_digit():
    from arrow.locales import PortugueseLocale
    locale = PortugueseLocale()
    for n in [1, 2, 3]:
        ordinal = locale.ordinal_number(n)
        assert ordinal.startswith(str(n)), f"Portuguese ordinal for {n} should start with {n}"

    }
